announcements.headline: To Present pre|CISION® Dual Payload Candidate
announcements.insight: Avacta Group presents pre|CISION® Dual Payload Candidate data following earlier platform highlights. This updates shareholder knowledge on pipeline progress.

announcements.headline: Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
announcements.insight: Avacta Group presents at a conference following recent data highlights. This supports earlier clinical updates but lacks specific financial implications.

announcements.headline: PFS Nearly Doubles with Faridoxorubicin Treatment
announcements.insight: Clinical data for Faridoxorubicin is presented alongside AVA6000 and AVA6103 at ESMO 2026. This updates the pre|CISION platform highlights from October.

announcements.headline: Highlights pre|CISION® Platform Data
announcements.insight: Data highlights follow the October fundraise and ESMO presentation. Shareholders should monitor how this platform data supports ongoing clinical development.

announcements.headline: To Present on AVA6000 and AVA6103 at ESMO 2026
announcements.insight: Avacta Group presents AVA6000 and AVA6103 at ESMO 2026. This follows a recent £12.5m fundraise completed in October.

announcements.headline: Notice of Interim Results Investor Meeting
announcements.insight: Avacta Group announces an interim results investor meeting. This follows the October fundraise and placing results.

announcements.headline: Capital Access Window - Avacta Group Plc
announcements.insight: Following the proposed fundraise in October, results of the placing and subscription are now confirmed. This completes the capital raising process initiated earlier this month.

announcements.headline: Results of Placing and Subscription
announcements.insight: The placing and subscription results confirm the completion of the October fundraise. This secures capital following the earlier proposal to raise approximately £12.5m.

announcements.headline: Proposed Fundraise to raise approximately £12.5m
announcements.insight: A fundraise follows recent clinical proof of mechanism and platform awards. This capital access window supports ongoing development efforts.

announcements.headline: Capital Access Window - Avacta Group Plc
announcements.insight: Avacta Group Plc announces a Capital Access Window following recent clinical and platform developments. Shareholders should monitor for details regarding potential capital raising.

announcements.headline: Capital Access Window
announcements.insight: Avacta Group appoints Mats Blom as Chair of the Audit Committee. This governance update follows recent clinical and platform developments.

announcements.headline: pre|CISION® Platform Wins R&D Achievement Award
announcements.insight: preCISION Platform wins an R&D award following clinical proof of mechanism in September. This validates AVA6103 potential but offers no financial terms.

announcements.headline: Further Demonstration of Potential of AVA6103
announcements.insight: Avacta Group demonstrates potential for AVA6103, following its September clinical proof of mechanism. This suggests continued development progress for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Clinical Proof of Mechanism for preCISION Platform
announcements.insight: Avacta Group provides clinical proof of mechanism for its preCISION Platform. This follows recent board appointments and capital raises, suggesting continued operational development.

announcements.headline: Mats Blom to Board as Chair of Audit Committee
announcements.insight: Mats Blom joins the board as Audit Committee Chair. This follows Patrick Vink’s appointment as Deputy Chairman in July and recent capital raises.

announcements.headline: Accelerated Payment Convertible Bond Installment
announcements.insight: Avacta Group makes another accelerated payment of a bond installment, following a similar action in July. This continues the repayment schedule established earlier this year.

announcements.headline: Accelerated Amortized Payment of Bond Installment
announcements.insight: Avacta Group adjusts bond repayment terms following its recent equity fundraise. This alters capital structure but lacks specific financial details for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Avacta Appoints Patrick Vink Deputy Chairman
announcements.insight: Patrick Vink is appointed Deputy Chairman following the June fundraise. This governance change may support the recent capital raising efforts.

announcements.headline: Oversubscribed Strategic Equity Fundraise of £9m
announcements.insight: The fundraise follows the AGM notice. Shareholders should watch for dilution effects from this oversubscribed placing.
